name: Enhance Prompt
description: Turn rough ideas into project-aware prompts for your coding agents: 5 context levels (rules, stack, git, relevant code), multiple models with fallback, history, and send straight to an agent terminal.

commands.title: Enhance Prompt: Show / hide the right sidebar (panel lives there)
Enhance Prompt: Cycle auto-enhance (off / rules / AI)
Enhance Prompt: Show / hide status bar item

statusBarItems.tooltip: Enhance Prompt: click to open the right sidebar (Ctrl+L), then the lightbulb tab.

settings.title: Panel language / Ngôn ngữ / 界面语言
settings.description: Language of the Enhance Prompt panel. Auto follows Orca.

settings.title: Status bar item
settings.description: Orca's status bar right-click menu only lists built-in items, so show or hide this plugin's item here (or with the command "Enhance Prompt: Show / hide status bar item").

settings.title: Output language
settings.description: Language of the enhanced prompt. The panel can also override it per prompt.

settings.title: Custom instructions
settings.description: Extra rules for the rewriter, e.g. your stack, coding conventions, or 'always ask the agent to run tests'.

settings.title: Project context level
settings.description: How much of the project the rewriter sees. Higher = more grounded prompts, slower and more tokens. Can be changed per prompt in the panel.
enumLabels: Standard: + AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/README, stack & commands, repo tree
Deep: + git status/diff/log and code relevant to the prompt
Max: + AI-picked files and the agent terminal output (2 model calls)

settings.title: Terminal lines (Max level)
settings.description: Recent lines of the target agent terminal to include at the Max level (0 = none).

settings.title: Always include files
settings.description: Paths relative to the workspace, one per line (e.g. docs/architecture.md). Standard level and above.

settings.title: Exclude from code search
settings.description: Glob-like patterns, one per line. .env files, keys and credentials are always excluded.
settings.default:
dist/
build/
out/
coverage/
*.lock
package-lock.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
*.min.js
*.map
*.snap

settings.title: Adapt to the target agent
settings.description: Shape the prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider… when a target agent is selected.

settings.title: Fallback to the next model
settings.description: When a model fails, try the next enabled model in the Models tab order.

settings.title: Fall back on
enumLabels: Any error (incl. bad key, unknown model)

settings.title: How to send multi-line prompts
settings.description: Bracketed paste keeps line breaks in Claude Code, Codex and most agent CLIs. Single line joins lines with spaces.

settings.title: Press Enter after sending
settings.description: Off lets you review the prompt in the agent before submitting it.

settings.title: History size
settings.description: How many enhancements to keep (0 turns history off).

settings.title: Notify when a long enhance finishes
settings.description: A desktop notification when a run takes more than 8 s. It names the model and the time, never your prompt.

settings.title: Auto-enhance prompts Orca sends to agents
settings.description: Applies to launch, task and orchestration prompts (Orca never hooks prompts you type yourself). Rules appends the text below instantly. AI rewrites with the model but Orca waits at most 2 s, so use a fast model; on timeout the original prompt is sent.

settings.title: Auto-enhance: text to append
settings.description: Used by the Rules mode.
settings.default: Before you finish: keep changes minimal and focused, follow the existing code style, run the relevant tests or type checks, and summarize what you changed.

settings.title: Auto-enhance: minimum prompt length
settings.description: Skip prompts shorter than this many characters.

settings.title: Auto-enhance: use cached project context
settings.description: AI mode adds the rules/stack context the plugin keeps warm for the focused workspace (no extra wait).

settings.title: Privacy: read project files
settings.description: Agent rules, README, manifests and the file list (Standard level and above).

settings.title: Privacy: run git
settings.description: Read-only git status, log, diff, ls-files and grep (Deep and Max levels).

settings.title: Privacy: read terminal output
settings.description: Last lines of the picked terminal (Max level only).

settings.title: Privacy: read other agents' sessions
settings.description: Max level: the other agents running in the workspace and the last lines of their terminals, with keys and passwords masked. Needs Privacy: read terminal output too.

settings.title: Other agents' sessions: agents read
settings.description: How many other agents to read, busiest first (1 to 8). Used only while "Privacy: read other agents' sessions" is on and confirmed.

settings.title: Other agents' sessions: lines per agent
settings.description: The last lines of each agent's terminal (10 to 300). Used only while "Privacy: read other agents' sessions" is on and confirmed.

settings.title: Privacy: watch what agents do
settings.description: Deep and Max levels: each tool an agent runs in Orca (its name and target: a file path or a command, never its output) and how sessions end, kept in memory for 45 minutes and sent with your prompts. Turning it on also needs your confirmation in the panel.

settings.title: Privacy: notice files you save
settings.description: Deep and Max levels: the paths of files you save in Orca's editor (never their text), kept in memory for 45 minutes; they rank first in the code search.

settings.title: Privacy: send to terminals
settings.description: Type the prompt into the terminal you pick when you click Send.

settings.title: Privacy: start new agents
settings.description: A button that starts a new agent (Claude Code, Codex…) in the workspace with the enhanced prompt. It runs with your permissions, like opening it yourself. Turning it on also needs your confirmation in the panel.

settings.title: Privacy: open files in Orca
settings.description: Clicking a file in the context list opens it in an editor tab.

settings.title: Privacy: save history
settings.description: Keep prompts in the History tab, on this machine only.

settings.title: Privacy: use API keys from environment variables
settings.description: OPENAI_API_KEY and the others, when a model has no saved key.

settings.title: Privacy: fetch model lists online
settings.description: GET /models from your providers and the Claude Code settings schema.
